name: Dot Cafe
notes: All 3 photos were legible printed menu boards (drink menu, food menu page 1, food menu page 2); merged into one menu.

dishes.name: Desi Chai
dishes.description: Traditional Indian chai, house-made masala cooked to order (please allow 7-10 minutes)

dishes.name: Energy Blend
dishes.description: red beets, gala apples, meyer lemon

dishes.name: Detox Blend
dishes.description: celery, granny smith apples, meyer lemon

dishes.name: Acai Bowl
dishes.description: raw acai blended with frozen bananas, berries, dot cafe granola, seasonal fruit, mikolich family honeycomb, bee pollen, hemp seeds, pistachios, coconut flakes.

dishes.name: Yogurt Parfait
dishes.description: local farmed yogurt, dot cafe granola, seasonal fruits and mikolich honeycomb

dishes.name: Toast & Spread
dishes.description: choice of ricotta & mikolich honeycomb with sea salt or roasted peanut butter and local fruit preserves and seasonal herb butter.

dishes.name: Avocado Toast
dishes.description: avocado mash with fresh squeezed lemon juice, local vegetables, balsamic reduction, pomegranate, parmesan tuile.

dishes.name: Eggs & Toast
dishes.description: eben-haezer ranch eggs, sourdough, cracked wheat, or baguette toast. choice of seasonal greens or seasonal fruit.

dishes.name: Beet Waffles
dishes.description: red beet waffles, local berries, cacao nibs, toasted walnuts, beet slices, honey beet sauce, fresh chantilly.

dishes.name: Breakfast Sliders
dishes.description: eben-haezer ranch eggs, black bean patty, garlic aioli, toasted brioche buns choice of seasonal greens or seasonal fruit

dishes.name: Seasonal Salad
dishes.description: mixed greens, wild rice, strawberries, toasted walnuts, persian cucumbers, feta cheese, watermelon radish, citrus pepper vinaigrette.

dishes.name: Cauliflower Steak
dishes.description: Seared mixed cauliflower on a green goddess herb hummus, morito chilli sauce, pickled vegetables, garlic herb chimichurri

dishes.name: Roasted Carrot Tacos
dishes.description: roasted baby carrots in an el pastor dry rub, pistachio and avocado mash, garlic crema, house-made blue corn tortillas, salsa macha. Side of fingerling potatoes, brussel sprouts, crumbled queso fresco and pomegranate

dishes.name: Farmer's Family (small)
dishes.description: shared showcase of our local farmers and makers. variety of seasonal fruits and vegetables, cheeses, and breads, locally crafted goods.
